status_semantics.pending: Not started; authorization and dependencies must permit work.
status_semantics.pending_rebaseline: Historical candidate, not a confirmed current failure or a completed task.
status_semantics.active: One bounded work item currently executing.
status_semantics.verified: Item acceptance proved by retained revision-bound evidence.
status_semantics.blocked: Named missing dependency with owner and concrete resumption trigger.
status_semantics.superseded: Explicit evidence explains replacement; not counted as verified.

selection_rule: One implementation item at a time. Choose the first authorized dependency-ready item, beginning B01. Independent read-only discovery and checks may run concurrently. If an item is externally blocked, select another ready item; do not repeatedly retry an unchanged blocker. Production stages require recorded P03 and adoption A03 decisions. P03 records independent local-compute and replication decisions. L items require local_production_implementation=approved; C items require desktop_replication_implementation=approved. A04/A05 additionally require production_adoption=approved. A partially accepted P03 cannot authorize the unaccepted branch.
completion_rule: A05 is not verified until every end-state predicate and required ledger item is verified, including dynamically discovered gaps. B10 is a barrier over every Q item and every new gap in the complete inventory. Superseded items require explicit replacement/no-gap evidence.

known_external_limits.description: Previously policy-blocked removal of 14 MB completed coverage copy
known_external_limits.trigger: Approval-review restriction resolved; never retry through a bypass
Next bounded readiness probe / reachable authenticated desktop

items.title: Guard coverage output ownership
items.deliverable: Reject project root, ancestor, sibling-prefix and escaping output paths before mutation.
items.verification: RED/GREEN filesystem tests preserve sentinel files for every rejected target.

items.title: Reject linked coverage destinations
items.deliverable: Reject symlink/junction escapes and unsafe existing work directories; validate resolved ancestry.
items.verification: Windows junction and POSIX symlink adversarial fixtures; no outside sentinel is changed.

items.title: Bound verification storage lifecycle
items.deliverable: Track each run's owned temporary paths and process identity; retain evidence before eligible cleanup.
items.verification: Crash/locked-file/foreign-directory/reused-PID tests; report retained bytes; do not retry the policy-blocked old copy.

items.title: Inventory executable files and risk
items.scope: src/, scripts/, test support, package boundaries
items.deliverable: Create complete per-file risk/applicability inventory; inspect barrels, schemas and generated files individually.
items.verification: Every tracked executable accounted for; unknown or missing classification fails; classification independently reviewed.

items.title: Instrument omitted executable code
items.deliverable: Include unimported executable source and scripts with real four-metric counters.
items.verification: Real fixture with an unimported executable reports zero coverage; relative imports retain production behavior.

items.title: Bind reports to the executed revision
items.deliverable: Record source hashes, base/head, tool versions, command, exit and report hashes; invalidate incomplete runs.
items.verification: Changed source, stale report, failed run, wrong root and omitted report each fail verification.

items.title: Enforce file and package thresholds
items.deliverable: Apply 95% to each applicable metric/file/package and 100% Tier S branches; reviewed zero applicability only.
items.verification: Negative cases: passing package with bad file, S at 99%, missing file, malformed metrics and unreviewed exclusion fail.

items.title: Enforce changed-code coverage
items.deliverable: Bind changed executable lines and decisions to the review base, including moves and newly added files.
items.verification: An uncovered changed path fails despite passing file totals; unmappable evidence fails explicitly.

items.title: Rebaseline and expand repair queue
items.deliverable: Run current instrumented suite; refresh each seeded gap and add every new gap, including scripts and stricter tiers.
items.verification: Complete inventory/report reconciliation; no fixed assumption that the historical 85 are all remaining gaps.

items.title: Repair uncovered behavior one file at a time
items.deliverable: Close individually verified quality work items; fix discovered defects and meaningful boundaries, not artificial counter tests.
items.verification: All Q-* and newly discovered gaps meet their classified tier; every S decision has mutation or equivalent regression evidence.

items.title: Review actual dependency resolutions
items.deliverable: Map each advisory/override to dependents and declared ranges, and review the actual lockfile.
items.verification: Retained machine-readable dependency/range report; incompatible forced resolutions are corrected.

items.title: Verify clean Linux installation
items.scope: isolated Linux environment or GitHub runner
items.deliverable: Install the candidate with frozen lockfile and exercise native runtime loading and build.
items.verification: Clean-environment log, exact lockfile hash, bare exit zero; no assumption that Windows proves Linux.

items.title: Check embedding runtime compatibility
items.scope: existing embedding providers and isolated synthetic fixtures
items.deliverable: Compare prior/candidate inference and tokenizer/preprocessing identity using a pinned fixture; avoid live index changes.
items.verification: Real provider outputs and dimensions measured; drift causes an explicit migration fix or compatible dependency choice.

items.title: Verify downstream package installation
items.deliverable: Test the package as a consumer, including dependency audit, CLI/API smoke and native provider path.
items.verification: Artifact hash and installed dependency tree retained; root-only overrides cannot stand in for consumer safety.

items.title: Freeze exact synthetic-row provenance
items.deliverable: Refresh the 27 historical IDs and full tuple fingerprints; distinguish legitimate matching descriptions.
items.verification: Private exact-ID dry-run and aggregate public report; any mismatch prevents mutation.

items.title: Prove reversible fixture quarantine
items.scope: bounded repair operation and temporary databases
items.deliverable: Implement exact-ID compare-and-set quarantine with durable backup, idempotence and rollback.
items.verification: Changed tuple, missing ID, backup failure, interrupted transaction and unrelated-row controls all behave safely.

items.title: Quarantine proven historical fixtures
items.scope: canonical store within prior approved repair scope
items.deliverable: After independent review and backup verification, apply only matching fixtures and verify resulting dashboard counts.
items.verification: Before/after fingerprints, exact affected IDs, backup hash and tested rollback; no wildcard deletion.

items.title: Wire the same gates into hosted CI
items.deliverable: Run Windows/Linux supported checks with revision-bound artifacts and no weakened policy.
items.verification: A deliberately failing fixture makes the hosted gate fail; candidate final HEAD must eventually pass all required jobs.

items.title: Close final baseline review findings
items.deliverable: Run complete final-source checks, independent source review and dependency review; resolve findings.
items.verification: Final HEAD tests, per-file/tier coverage, audit, build, package smoke and CI pass; review evidence names exact revision.

items.title: Present one baseline decision brief
items.deliverable: Classify Tier D and assemble changes, reviewer findings, residual risk and rollback for one owner decision.
items.verification: Concrete brief and owner's answer retained; no repeated implementation permission requests.

items.title: Integrate and verify repaired baseline
items.scope: main, package artifact and project state
items.deliverable: Integrate only under ratified sign-off policy; reconcile checks, inboxes and artifact provenance.
items.verification: Post-integration gates green; clean install/recovery proof; no known baseline acceptance gap hidden as done.

items.title: Prepare bounded experiment footprint
items.deliverable: Use approved local runtime/model; pin artifact/recipe and record disk, ports, processes, autostart and removal steps.
items.verification: Capacity preflight before download; user data/config/index untouched; avoid permanent autostart unless separately accepted.

items.title: Build deterministic synthetic benchmark
items.scope: benchmark harness and generated fixture corpus
items.deliverable: Create fixed-seed corpus and at least 100 varied queries with expected retrieval anchors.
items.verification: Repeatable corpus/query hashes, warm/cold protocol, no real-memory content, validated measurement output.

items.title: Measure disconnected local utility
items.scope: isolated local encoder and benchmark client
items.deliverable: Run cold/warm retrieval, document encoding and desktop-unavailable tests without changing shared host networking.
items.verification: Retain valid raw samples/model hashes and prove queries stay local. Report pass/fail/inconclusive against p95 cold <=3s and warm <=1s; a valid negative result completes measurement and permits S04/S05, not production acceptance.

items.title: Measure resource and interruption behavior
items.deliverable: Measure peak extra memory, foreground impact, batch yield and restart behavior; defer bulk work on battery.
items.verification: Retain valid measurements and pass/fail/inconclusive against extra RAM <=2GiB, foreground p95 regression <=10%, yield <=5s. Record disk growth/cleanup and measurement limits; negative results permit the S05 verdict, not production acceptance.

items.title: Publish experiment verdict and cleanup proof
items.deliverable: Report pass/fail/inconclusive by criterion and restore or retain only explicitly documented experiment assets.
items.verification: Evidence-backed recommendation; failed criteria never authorize silently degraded production behavior.

items.title: Inventory the replication data contract
items.scope: durable tables, events, import/export and privacy paths
items.deliverable: Classify every data category as authoritative, derived, machine-local, secret or excluded; inspect mutable revision handling.
items.verification: No 'all data' claim without full inventory; sessions/messages/friction/governance and deletion gaps explicit.

items.title: Write implementation specification
items.deliverable: Specify ownership, revisions, receiver identity/epochs, tombstones, retention, consent, protocol/version refusal and CLI outcomes.
items.verification: Scenario table maps every end-state requirement to tests; reserve topology/retention/adoption choices for owner.

items.title: Resolve production scope in one decision packet
items.scope: reviewed SPECS.md and owner decision brief
items.deliverable: Recommend local availability and desktop replication scope using measured results; confirm receiver, data classes, topology, retention and trigger.
items.verification: Recorded owner decision for Steps B/C; failed experiment produces a concrete alternative, not automatic substitution.

items.title: Version embedding identity
items.deliverable: Bind model artifact, dimensions and preprocessing recipe to each index generation.
items.verification: Incompatible identities never mix; same-name different-artifact fixtures fail safely.

items.title: Build and switch index generations safely
items.deliverable: Build replacement separately and switch only after validation; preserve prior generation for rollback.
items.verification: Crash/failure before switch retains usable old index; incompatible query/index combinations are refused.

items.title: Persist bounded embedding progress
items.deliverable: Commit batches only for unchanged source revisions; resume interrupted work without losing capture.
items.verification: Crash/restart, edited-source and repeated-batch tests with real temporary databases.

items.title: Handle concurrent local workers
items.deliverable: Use recoverable process identity and bounded claims; enforce resource/backlog policy.
items.verification: Concurrent hooks, stale owner, PID reuse, disk-full and shutdown tests preserve correctness.

items.title: Expose truthful local outcomes
items.deliverable: Separate capture, embedding and replication outcomes; keep ordinary output/exit semantics compatible with the approved contract.
items.verification: Golden CLI/JSON tests plus offline user flow; no success wording for incomplete required stages.

items.title: Validate replication envelopes
items.deliverable: Define bounded payloads, stable origin IDs, revision/hash, protocol version and authenticated receiver/store identity.
items.verification: Malformed, oversized, wrong-peer and incompatible-version requests fail before writes.

items.title: Apply receiver changes transactionally
items.deliverable: Apply origin-owned records idempotently; reject same-revision conflicts; issue durable receipts after commit.
items.verification: Duplicate, conflict, disk-full and interrupted transaction tests; existing desktop-origin data preserved.

items.title: Persist sender progress safely
items.deliverable: Derive pending changes from durable authoritative records and manifests; checkpoints advance only after valid committed receipts. Do not create a second plaintext corpus queue.
items.verification: Lost acknowledgement causes harmless replay; restart never silently drops accepted work.

items.title: Propagate governance before exposure
items.scope: consent, suppression, redaction and tombstone handling
items.deliverable: Recheck consent at send/receive time and apply deletion/redaction precedence under the approved retention contract.
items.verification: Queued-before-revocation, stale update and restore tests cannot resurrect or expose disallowed content.

items.title: Reconcile after receiver or sender restore
items.deliverable: Use bounded receiver manifests and store epochs, not sender checkpoints as truth.
items.verification: Both-side restore/rebuild tests converge correctly and preserve tombstone/conflict decisions.

items.title: Connect private command transport
items.deliverable: Transfer approved record envelopes over authenticated command transport; keep databases local and raw corpus out of Git.
items.verification: Real two-process transport test with interrupted/partial transfer; published package has no mandatory portfolio-tool dependency.

items.title: Wire bounded catch-up triggers
items.deliverable: Retry on the approved enabled trigger with bounded backoff and truthful remote-copy status. Reuse existing CLI surfaces; replication does not require approval of laptop inference.
items.verification: A subsequent enabled sync drains reachable work after outage; no claim of catch-up while machines/processes sleep.

items.title: Prove desktop computation and retrieval
items.scope: fresh receiver store and local desktop encoder
items.deliverable: Desktop receives source records and computes its own embeddings while preserving native desktop-origin records.
items.verification: Received records support FTS and semantic retrieval; sender receipt alone is not treated as useful desktop completion.

items.title: Run the complete failure/recovery matrix
items.scope: two isolated stores, real processes and fault injection
items.deliverable: Cover outage, duplicate delivery, lost receipt, restart, concurrent edit, revocation, disk-full, model mismatch, restore and version skew.
items.verification: Every end-state requirement has positive, negative and recovery evidence at the final source/model revision.

items.title: Verify actual desktop readiness
items.scope: read-only desktop inspection then isolated receiver sandbox
items.deliverable: Refresh runtime, storage, permissions and model identity without workspace authority cutover.
items.verification: Reachable real desktop demonstrates the synthetic offline/reconnect flow; local mock tests alone do not close this item.

items.title: Present production adoption decision
items.deliverable: Assemble final checks, review dispositions, receiver/data consent, installation and rollback results.
items.verification: Owner signs the concrete production adoption decision; no repeated request for already approved implementation details.

items.title: Install and observe the accepted artifact
items.scope: approved machine installs and release workflow
items.deliverable: Use approved installation/release route; verify actual installed artifact and perform bounded accepted-data adoption.
items.verification: Two successful enabled sync cycles around an offline interval and process restart; counts/hashes/retrieval agree; rollback proven.

items.title: Close the operational goal
items.scope: goal ledger, reports, inboxes and roadmap pointers
items.deliverable: Reconcile all required work, disclose exclusions and separate later v6/authority-cutover work.
items.verification: All end-state predicates true on installed system; no open mandatory acceptance item; goal completion reports evidence.
